snippet.title: Pixel Cartographer - Trailer / Demo
snippet.description:
For years I also drooled over the maps in Final Fantasy Tactics Advanced, and Tactics Ogre ~ so I finally made my own map builder game! Creating to your hearts content, each map location has 2 requirements you must meet and some prebuilt terrain for you to work with. But of course there's also a Sandbox mode to go wild with!

Demo / Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5281980


#indiegame #cozygame #pixelartgames
